title: Find Something RED! ❤️ Learn Colors with Luna #shorts
description:
Luna the bunny is painting! Can you find something red? A tiny Buttercup Hollow learning story about colors for toddlers.

#shorts #colorsforkids #learncolors #toddlerlearning

scenes.image_prompt: Luna the lavender bunny standing at a small easel with a paintbrush, a pot of bright red paint next to her
scenes.motion_prompt: the bunny dips her brush in red paint and smiles

lines.text: So pretty! This color is red!

scenes.image_prompt: Luna the lavender bunny pointing at a shiny red apple on a branch
Luna the bunny pointing at Pip the chick's little red sneakers, Pip proudly showing them
Luna the bunny smiling at the viewer next to a red flower, inviting gesture

lines.text: Can you find something red near you?
